title: Dating the split from Nazarro, second marriage and return from Germany
summary: Tape side change; he dates the split to about 1945, his second marriage, and a return from Germany in '53 after four years.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

Well, then did Nazarro pay the $125?
Yes, he did, so we went back.
So it was in 1948 that you split from Nazarro?
It was 1945, I think, when I got married.
To your new wife.
Yeah -- second wife.
Then you split from Nazarro in '45 -- '48. And then when did you leave for Germany?
I came back in '53 and I was over there four years.
So you left Germany in '49, a year later after you split from Nazarro. So in between the time you were
in "Varsity Show" which was in '37 and '48, a 10-year period, you were still with Nazarro.
The time of what?
The time of "Varsity Show" which was 1937 to 1948 you were still with Nazarro. How long was your lawsuit?
When did I go to Canada?
'38, right after "Varsity Show."
How long was the lawsuit, you said that the lawsuit was long and drawn out. Was it?
No, it was a long time getting to it. A long time getting to the lawsuit 'cause I didn't go to court with it.
How long were you with Nazarro -- That 10-year period in between "Varsity Show" and the time that you split with Nazarro, what were you doing?
I was playing
the dates I told ya, the little restaurant on 46th Street. I told you about that, that's the time between that --
